div.div:
Each application must point at the gateway. Routing does not do this.
DNS does not do this. A proxy setting does not do this.
An application that still points at the provider continues to work. The
gateway cannot see it. Make a list of all your applications first.

div.div:
With stream: true, an Open AI compatible provider sends no usage data.
The gateway then logs zero tokens and zero cost. The budget does not
see the spend.
To correct this, the application must also send
stream_options: {include_usage: true}.
